text: 中国人民银行新闻发言人、副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，上半年央行各项工具投放量有效对冲了缴纳存款准备金、现金投放等因素带来的1万亿流动性缺口，货币市场隔夜利率DR001前6个月均值为1.31%，总体运行平稳。
text_en: PBOC spokesperson and Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that in the first half of the year, the central bank's various tool injections effectively offset the 1 trillion yuan liquidity gap from factors like reserve requirement deposits and cash issuance, with the overnight interbank rate DR001 averaging 1.31% in the first six months, running steadily overall.
